correctness.rationale: The bilinear Bochner identities produce exactly ((Delta+lambda_2l)(Delta+lambda_(2l-2)))/(lambda_2l lambda_(2l-2)) on each product. Nonzero Jacobi projections of t^l prove all even product sectors span, making exact parity-design moments necessary. Factorization fixes coefficients and proves sharp positivity.
